message.content: No specific announcement regarding the new high-protein bread line was made prior to Hailey Johnson inviting Li Hua to the special bakery event. The invitation was sent out to gather feedback on the new gluten-free bread line, which was introduced around the same time. There is no mention of high-protein breads in the emails exchanged between Hailey and Li Hua prior to the event. However, the new gluten-free bread line was announced earlier, on April 2nd, and was part of the promotional activities leading up to the event.
